newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Boxed beef firmer but some disappointment over fed sales at $68.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Index up to 26 month high and corn futures seen easier.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Steady to instances weak live calls and lower pork cutout values.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.500 to 1.000 cent. Bullish out-of-town report, strong cash and light hog kill. But technically weak.
